name: CoA Custom races: .hidearmor hides the visible armor, keeps it equipped and survives a relog
contract: .hidearmor is part of the CoA Custom races package (1.5.1) and any player may use it.
It clears the visible-item fields of the armor slots (head, shoulders, shirt, chest, waist, legs, feet, wrists, hands, back, tabard) while the items stay equipped; weapons stay visible.
The choice is stored in characters.coa_hide_armor and applied again at login; typing the command again shows the armor.
Native visible-item fields (PLAYER_VISIBLE_ITEM_n_ENTRYID) and equipped items are observed; the client's rendering is not.

steps.label: CONTROL: the chest piece is visible
DISCRIMINATING: the chest piece is no longer visible
The hidden armor is remembered across the relog
The chest piece is visible again
